prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en gäst". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "guest".
Scene: A host welcoming a dinner guest to a warmly set dining table.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "gäst resembles guest.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vi har en gäst på middag.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
